reason: The README describes a plugin discovery workflow that searches public GitHub repositories, ranks and inspects candidates, scans the selected commit statically, and installs the user-selected plugin.

summaries.zh: 这是一个根据用户任务搜索、筛选并在静态扫描后安装 DeepSeek Harness 插件的工具。
summaries.en: A plugin discovery tool that searches, ranks, statically scans, and installs DeepSeek Harness plugins selected by the user.

capabilities: Searches public GitHub repositories by topic
Ranks and inspects candidate plugins against a user request
Pins a selected plugin to an exact commit
Runs static security scanning on plugin source
Installs a user-selected plugin after review
